class.name: SlangShaderFile
class.description: Compiled Slang shader with SPIR-V and reflection information for each program it declares. Every compiled program in the file is listed in [member programs]. A compute entry-point becomes one program on its own; a vertex and a fragment entry-point are linked together into a single raster pass program. Check [member SlangShaderProgram.stages] to tell them apart. In most cases, this can be used as a drop-in replacement for [RDShaderFile].

method.name: get_spirv
method.description: Returns the SPIR-V intermediate representation of the specified program (at [param program_index]), with one bytecode entry per shader stage it provides.

method.name: get_version_list
method.description: Returns the list of compiled versions for this shader. This is always empty for Slang shaders.

method.name: set_bytecode
method.description: Sets the SPIR-V [param bytecode] that will be compiled for the specified program (at [param program_index]).

members.member: The base compilation error message, which indicates errors not related to a specific shader stage if non-empty. If empty, shader compilation is not necessarily successful (check each [SlangShaderProgram]'s [RDShaderSPIRV] error message members).
Every program compiled from this shader file: one per compute entry-point, plus one for each vertex/fragment pair linked into a raster pass.

Get the reflection information of the global parameters for this shader. You typically won't need to access this, but it is used under the hood by [SlangShaderTask] to bind data to the correct descriptor slots.

constants.constant: Matrices are stored using row-major order.
Matrices are stored using column-major order.
